readiness_assessment.rule: Development diagnosis only: assess prediction consistency and actual selected outcomes with costs; no promotion based solely on changed G/S target or reduced prediction mass. A complete-policy matrix requires a separately frozen explicit rollout protocol.
readiness_assessment.independence: These old states and reference data are development evidence; not independent held-out validation.
readiness_assessment.aggregation: Per-state ranks and absolute quantities first, then equal-weight summary over six paired development states; 66 candidates are dependent, not 66 independent trials.
readiness_assessment.shrinkage_check: Check absolute supported and realized hypothesis weight alongside supported fraction and unique actual source area. Source-to-predicted-point nearest-neighbor recall at5cm is not used because template quadrature spacing can exceed5cm.
readiness_assessment.stage_comparison: Three declared stages separate object-only template support, the inherited height-crop correction and point-plane shape fitting, using the same6originalstates and66measuredbranches. G/S share actual observed supports; no statistical independence or natural detection claim.
